turns.text: My lover's got humour, she's the giggle at a funeral
turns.zh: 我的爱人很有幽默感，她是葬礼上的那声轻笑

turns.text: Knows everybody's disapproval, they should've worshipped her sooner
turns.zh: 她看透了所有人的不认可，他们早该崇拜她了

turns.text: If the heavens ever did speak, she's the last true mouthpiece
turns.zh: 如果上天曾经开口说话，她就是最后一位真正的代言人

turns.text: Every Sunday's getting more bleak, a fresh poison each week
turns.zh: 每个星期天都越来越凄凉，每周都有新的毒药

turns.text: "We were born sick"
turns.zh: 「我们生来就有病」

turns.text: You heard them say it
turns.zh: 你听他们这么说过

turns.text: My church offers no absolutes, she tells me, "Worship in the bedroom"
turns.zh: 我的教会不提供任何绝对真理，她告诉我：「在卧室里崇拜吧」

turns.text: The only Heaven I'll be sent to is when I'm alone with you
turns.zh: 我唯一会被送去的天堂，就是和你独处的时候

turns.text: I was born sick, but I love it
turns.zh: 我生来就有病，但我喜欢这样

turns.text: Command me to be well
turns.zh: 命令我好起来吧

turns.text: A-, amen
turns.zh: 阿——阿门

turns.text: Amen, amen
turns.zh: 阿门，阿门

turns.text: Take me to church, I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies
turns.zh: 带我去教堂，我会像狗一样在你谎言的圣坛前崇拜

turns.text: I'll tell you my sins, and you can sharpen your knife
turns.zh: 我会向你坦白我的罪，你可以磨快你的刀

turns.text: Offer me that deathless death, oh, good God, let me give you my life
turns.zh: 赐我那不朽的死亡吧，哦，天哪，让我把生命献给你

turns.text: Take me to church, I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies

turns.zh: 赐我那不朽的死亡吧，哦，天哪，让我把生命献给你

turns.text: If I'm a pagan of the good times, my lover's the sunlight
turns.zh: 如果我是美好时光里的异教徒，我的爱人就是那阳光

turns.text: To keep the goddess on my side, she demands a sacrifice
turns.zh: 为了让女神留在我身边，她要求献祭

turns.text: Drain the whole sea, get something shiny
turns.zh: 抽干整片海，找点闪闪发光的东西

turns.text: Something meaty for the main course, that's a fine looking high horse
turns.zh: 主菜得有点肉，那匹高头大马看起来不错

turns.text: What you got in the stable? We've a lot of starving faithful
turns.zh: 你的马厩里有什么？我们有很多饥饿的信徒

turns.text: That looks tasty, that looks plenty, this is hungry work
turns.zh: 那看起来很好吃，那看起来很多，这可是饿着肚子干的活

turns.text: No masters or kings when the ritual begins
turns.zh: 仪式开始时，没有主人也没有国王

turns.text: There is no sweeter innocence than our gentle sin
turns.zh: 没有比我们温柔的罪更甜美的纯真了

turns.text: In the madness and soil of that sad earthly scene
turns.zh: 在那疯狂与那悲伤尘世的泥土中

turns.text: Only then, I am human
turns.zh: 只有那时，我才是个真正的人

turns.text: Only then, I am clean
turns.zh: 只有那时，我才洁净
